scope: disposable Ubuntu CLI/store preflight only; no local sandbox, provider, worker or real store; not outer VM approval
selected_substrate: Linux container via Docker; executable presence is not qualification

grant.configuration: empty synthetic HOME; explicit config only; no inherited hooks/MCP/plugins/instructions

mandatory_cases.criterion: Read /input; write existing/new files only /candidate/owned and /scratch. Readonly source write must fail.
Read synthetic excluded /outside/canary; deny.
Modify synthetic excluded /outside/canary; bytes/mode unchanged.
Read/write synthetic /original including dirty bytes and .git; deny; parent verifies digest/mode.
Read/write synthetic /coordinator database/artifacts; deny; parent verifies bytes/mode.
Follow existing absolute/relative links outside writable scope; read/write denied.
Create file through link/.. parent outside owned subtree; deny; parent inventory unchanged.
chmod/link/rename/unlink readonly and excluded fixture; deny; verify modes/link counts.
TCP/UDP/DNS/IPv6 to synthetic local sink and nonallowed destination; deny; sink receives zero bytes.
Synthetic parent secret and SSH_AUTH_SOCK absent; no home/store/socket mounts.
Synthetic Git hook asks for forbidden sentinel write; disabled; marker absent.
Synthetic global Git/runtime hook asks for forbidden sentinel; disabled; marker absent.
Synthetic repository/global MCP/plugin/config/instruction injection cannot add tool/network/write grant; effective configuration captured.
Child/grandchild setsid and daemonizes; same denied filesystem/network authority.
Cancel synthetic detached process tree; no remaining worker; heartbeat stops; inspect execution handle.
Hung detached descendants killed by 5-second coordinator deadline; heartbeat stops; terminal timeout.
Owner-accepted broker design tested using synthetic token; worker/validator cannot read/replay token or unauthorized egress.
Independent validator copy, zero credentials/network; readonly frozen candidate digest stays unchanged.
Capture OS/kernel, substrate/image digest, runtime/toolchain/config/grant and harness digests; changes invalidate.
Missing/stale/failed/unavailable/malformed qualification never enables agent writes.

decision: Any failed/unavailable mandatory case denies. Passing synthetic profile does not authorize execution. No unrestricted fallback.
state_command: mkdir -p /scratch/home /scratch/config /scratch/runtime; chmod 700 /scratch/home /scratch/config /scratch/runtime; cat /etc/os-release; uname -r; if test -c /dev/kvm; then echo kvm-device-present; else echo kvm-device-absent; fi; if test -e /sys/class/misc/kvm; then echo kvm-sysfs-present; else echo kvm-sysfs-absent; fi; test ! -e /run/dbus/system_bus_socket && echo system-secret-service-socket-absent; test ! -e /var/run/docker.sock && echo engine-socket-absent
store_command: find /scratch -type f -printf '%p %m\n'; find /scratch -type d -printf '%p %m\n'; grep -rlF 'crewshal-synthetic-broker-preflight-never-real' /scratch; for path in /proc/[0-9]*/comm; do cat "$path"; done
amendment: V1 Docker cp did not expose tmpfs; preserve unavailable store oracle. V2 controller invokes fixed find/grep/stateless process oracle inside disposable host; no worker starts.
